# simple "git refresh" strategy

Attach housekeeping to `git pull` through a hook, so that a repository can declare tasks to run after every update — remove unwanted tags, rename a branch, and the like. The motivating case is forks: pulling from `upstream` brings tags and branches the fork does not want, and today they have to be cleaned by hand each time.
